papers.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: Pushing the Limits of KV Cache Compression
papers.desc: The widespread adoption of long-horizon agents has made model workloads increasingly input-heavy.

papers.title: Can MiniMax-H3 Reason About the Physical World? An Evaluation of Omni-Modal Generative Model
papers.desc: Recent Omni-Modal Generative Models (Omni-Models) have advanced content generation toward unified modeling of text, images, video, and audio.

papers.title: When EOS Tokens Disagree: Understanding Length Inflation in On-Policy Distillation
papers.desc: We study length inflation in on-policy distillation (OPD), where student responses can become excessively long and even exhaust the generation budget.

papers.title: RetireOPD: Self-Retiring On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.desc: Multi-turn agents trained with reinforcement learning (RL) receive a single scalar reward per trajectory, which motivates self on-policy distillation (OPD) to supply dense token-level supervision from a self-teacher with privileged task skills, letting a skill-free student internalize them.

papers.title: Reflect, Revise, Reuse: Training-Free Skill Evolution for GUI Agents
papers.desc: GUI agents execute long-horizon tasks on dynamic graphical user interfaces, where pop-ups, delayed loads, and relocated widgets routinely invalidate plans fixed before execution.

papers.title: WeVisDoc: From Coverage to Capability for Robust End-to-End Document Parsing
papers.desc: Document parsing converts document images into structured content and requires reliable performance across diverse layouts and acquisition conditions.

papers.title: FAMOS: Feed-Forward 3D Articulation Modeling from Sparse Observations
papers.desc: Modeling articulated objects from sparse monocular views is challenging because each observation reveals only partial geometry and motion evidence.

papers.title: UFO: Chain-of-Evaluation for Omni-Condition Alignment in Multi-Modal Image Generation
papers.desc: Multi-modal image generation, particularly subject-driven customization, has garnered growing attention in recent years.

papers.title: When2Think: Learning Difficulty-Aware Length Control for Efficient Hybrid Reasoning Models
papers.desc: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) achieve strong performance on complex tasks but exhibit systematic inefficiency: they often overthink easy problems and underthink hard ones.

papers.title: What Does Privileged Information Add to On-Policy Self-Distillation?
papers.desc: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) lets a language model learn from a frozen copy of itself that sees an answer or a worked solution.

papers.title: Don't Mask the Environment: Observation Supervision Changes How Agents Explore Under RL
papers.desc: Agent trajectories record what an agent does and what happens next.

papers.title: PACT: Can Enterprise AI Assistants Be Trusted Under Pressure?
papers.desc: As corporate AI adoption continues to grow, enterprise-grade LLM agents are being deployed into sensitive contexts such as hiring, healthcare, and finance.

papers.title: VākQA: A Benchmark and Evaluation Study for Telugu Spoken Factoid Question Answering
papers.desc: Question answering has advanced rapidly with large language models, but predominantly for high-resource languages, in both text and spoken settings.

papers.title: Srijika: OpenType-Layout-Reusing Font Restyling for Nine Indic Scripts
papers.desc: We present Srijika, a system for producing installable OpenType fonts for nine Brahmic scripts: Devanagari, Tamil, Bengali, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Gujarati, Gurmukhi, and Odia.

papers.title: Sample Count Is Not Enough: Candidate-Generation Strategy Shapes the Energy and Performance of LLM Test-Time Scaling
papers.desc: Test-time scaling can improve large language model reasoning by generating and combining multiple candidate responses.
